limits: Returned character counts and literal hook-presence checks are local diagnostics, not provider-token attribution or semantic coverage grading.
All API trajectories and all three repetitions remain in the frozen summary.
Fixed observed queries replayed on both frozen sources; no adaptive counterfactual model run.
Different replies establish exposure to the ranking change, not answer improvement or token savings.
Explicit-file/range calls bypass discovery and are not replayed here; scope errors remain in API totals.

diagnosis: All67 recorded reader discovery calls (49 distinct corpus/query inputs) reproduced exactly; switching frozen ranking sources changed zero replies in98 offline dispatches. The measured arm gap is not evidence of a reply-mediated ranking regression.
Candidate used20 native reads and113 provider requests versus prior-reader9 reads and97 requests. Of66165 extra provider tokens,65698 were input and467 output; no counterfactual savings are inferred.
Candidate minus native corpus totals: Pluggy+34144 and Attrs+15427 dominate increases; Jinja-21167 and Click-16188 are substantial savings. All wins/losses remain counted.

Candidate search scopes still produced12 empty-array errors and one directory error; prior-reader produced11 empty-array errors and one wrong-path error. These are retained tool errors, not generation failures.

All six reader Attrs trajectories received the complete setter-hook implementation. Two candidate answers omitted its existing-validator condition; the third falsely asserted a flag-only bypass. These failures are not explained by absent hook text.
No further ranking retuning, catalog promotion or reserved evaluation follows from this failed gate.

grading_isolation.method: Intended arm-blind coding-assistant source review; not independent human validation.
grading_isolation.group05: No unrelated content observed; generic prepare/write state prompted an extra parent check, which verified all12 identities and48 own-answer quotes.
grading_isolation.mitigation: Broadcast unique namespaces/function-local state; affected reviewers reloaded only assigned packets and disregarded accidental unrelated output.
grading_isolation.limitation: Mechanical identity/quote checks do not restore strict per-question isolation or constitute independent human adjudication.

accepted_production.origin: Previously parent-executed exact-source offline acceptance; not rerun or synthetic model results.

verification.fixture_correction: OS-lock smoke passed initially; checkpoint fixture first retained an old copied ceiling and was correctly rejected. Only that synthetic fixture was corrected, then checkpoint-only checks passed. No API retry or driver change.

limitations: Ten reused original questions, not thirty independent questions; question-cluster bootstrap keeps all three paired repetitions together. Repository sensitivity also reported.
One answering model and reused Python repositories; broad confidence intervals and no universal quality/token-superiority claim.

Coding-assistant grading is not independent human validation. Shared Eval globals exposed unrelated blind answers to three reviewers; mitigation and all identity/quote checks are recorded, but strict per-question isolation was weakened.

No realized discovery reply changed between reader sources. The diagnostic arm comparison therefore does not establish a causal effect of qualified-definition ranking on token usage or answer accuracy.
The diagnostic prior-reader scored better in this sample but cannot replace the prespecified candidate after unblinding. Its earlier three-repetition study failed its gate.
Tool-error counts, local returned-character counts and fixed-input replay are diagnostics, not provider-token attribution or adaptive counterfactual savings.
